name: Controller with remappable back buttons
summary: Back paddles let you keep your thumbs on the sticks while pressing actions that normally require moving a thumb to the face buttons, which is useful in shooters and action games.
lookFor: Compatibility with your platform (PC, PlayStation, Xbox or Nintendo) and whether features work on each
Paddles you can reach comfortably without pressing them by accident
Stick quality and, where offered, replaceable stick modules, since drift is a common failure on all controllers
Adjustable trigger stops and a comfortable shape for your hand size
Wired mode available for the lowest latency and no charging worries
suitableFor: Controller players who want more actions available without taking their thumbs off the sticks.
pros: More control options without moving your thumbs
Useful for accessibility as well as competitive play
cons: Can cost much more than a standard controller
Not every game or platform supports every feature
